lion.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: twelve-frame transparent 2D game animation sprite sheet, STRICT 4 columns and 3 rows. Reference is the existing animated animal design. Match its precise head, proportions, fur colors, outline and shading. Use the same head and torso size in EVERY frame. All complete animals face LEFT in strict side profile. Entire tail, ears and paws visible, no cropping. Generous transparent gutters between EVERY silhouette, no touching. Actual alpha transparency, absolutely no drawn background, shadow, mud, water, log, ground, splashes, labels or text.
Row 1 is FOUR consecutive frames of ONE cautious quadruped WALK cycle on a narrow log. Body lowered, slow measured gait, THREE paws on the same invisible horizontal ground at a time, one paw lifts a little. Do not run or leap.
Frame 1 near front paw planted forward; far front paw starts lifting beneath chest.
Frame 2 near front paw remains grounded farther back relative to torso; far front paw reaches forward just above ground.
Frame 3 far front paw planted forward; near front paw lifts beneath chest; hind legs alternate.
Frame 4 far front paw grounded farther back relative to torso; near front paw reaches forward just above ground. Tail balances gently, torso remains the same size and position.
Row 2 is FOUR consecutive frames of ONE heavy sticky MUD pull cycle, full body without any drawn mud. Horizontal low torso, rear legs bent and braced, shoulders visibly tense, no gliding or graceful swimming pose. Keep paws anatomically attached and distinct.
Frame 1 front paw lifts toward chest and reaches forward, other paw braced below belly.
Frame 2 the reaching paw drives DOWN from chest level to below belly to dig into thick mud.
Frame 3 the planted paw pulls BACK low below belly with muscular effort, head lowered a little.
Frame 4 pulling paw recovers slowly up toward chest, other forepaw prepares to dig. Torso and head size unchanged, belly stays low.
Row 3 is FOUR consecutive frames of ONE log-riding water PADDLE cycle. The animal is belly-down, resting on a small log that must NOT be drawn. Keep hips and belly at an identical horizontal height in all four frames. Rear legs rest along the log. FRONT PAWS are spread to the sides and extend DOWN BELOW THE BELLY to reach the water. Never raise hands into the air or ahead of the head.
Frame 1 both elbows beside chest, near paw down and forward below belly.
Frame 2 near paw sweeps down/back, far paw reaches down/forward.
Frame 3 near paw fully back below belly, far paw sweeps down/back.
Frame 4 near paw returns forward very low, far paw finishes backward stroke. All four show paws below belly. The intended water line will cover the hands while the body stays on its log.
Coherent expressive hand-drawn animated/cartoon style EXACTLY matching the reference. Clear limbs and feet, fine animation increments, consistent body scale, friendly polished game art. No photorealism, no 3D rendering, no realistic background.
Animal identity: Golden lion, dark brown mane, cream muzzle, dark tail tuft.
